receipts.detail: The release failed only in admin-cdc-propagation's third INSERT witness before any npm, Docker, Helm, SEA, or GitHub publication. A deterministic probe showed an undated absent-key INSERT is correctly fenced after authoritative absence, while updated_at=observedAt+1 is admitted; the blocker was scenario causality, not notification latency or cache correctness.

96 assertions prove one stable production Admin listener, same-cache idempotence, typed and atomic owner handoff, old-cache non-delivery, shutdown detachment, restart restoration, and fulfilled or rejected retired-owner attempts being discarded and re-driven.

The 970-assertion protected cone covers shutdown/handoff and shutdown/restart overlap, mixed snapshots plus fulfilled and rejected retired attempts across every awaited resolver boundary, old/new repair and probe overlap, reconcile fencing, failure-backoff reset, listener continuity, and unchanged cache behavior.
